title: Eye implant that restores vision lost to age approved for use | New Scientist
description: An eye implant and a pair of high-tech glasses that enable people with a severe form of vision loss to read have been approved for use by a European regulator
author: Oluoma Aneke

title: One of NASA’s crucial links to deep space is at risk of burning down | New Scientist
description: The Deep Space Network is our best way to communicate with spacecraft beyond Earth’s orbit, and one of its three stations around the world is in the middle of a wildfire
author: Leah Crane

title: Clothes made from living fungi can clean and repair themselves | New Scientist
description: Researchers have created a textile made from the parasitic fungus Cordyceps militaris, which is biodegradable and can be adapted for different purposes with various microbes
author: James Woodford

title: Having a young biological age could help with weight loss | New Scientist
description: In a small study, restricting calories led to greater weight loss among people with a biological age younger than their chronological age
author: Emma Young

title: 10 of the best pictures of solar eclipses throughout history | New Scientist
description: Humans have been observing solar eclipses for millennia – carving, painting, sketching and finally photographing as the moon blocks out the disc of the sun
author: Leah Crane

title: Most neurons seem to be jacks-of-all-trades, not specialists | New Scientist
description: We tend to think of the brain as being made up of highly specialised cells, but a study in mice suggests that most neurons are generalists
author: Nora Bradford
